public.text: The recommendation to resist complex capabilities until foundations are stable may be interpreted as preventing countries from addressing urgent clinical, surveillance, or emergency needs through targeted solutions.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that urgent services may proceed in parallel, provided they do not create avoidable lock-in and are designed for later conformance, integration, or retirement.
